host.rebootMsg: Every app, terminal and remote session closes. NoCapOS is back in a minute or two, and this page reconnects on its own.
host.shutdownMsg: Every app and session closes and the machine powers off. Heads up: you'll need physical access (or your host's console) to turn it back on.
host.wifiOffMsg: If you're reaching NoCapOS over this machine's Wi-Fi, this page loses its connection and you'll need local access to turn it back on.
host.netOffMsg: This disconnects every network on this machine. If you're using NoCapOS remotely, you're locked out until someone turns networking back on locally.
host.ipMsg: {iface} will {desc}. If this page reaches NoCapOS through {iface}, it may blip for a sec. You'll be asked to keep the change — if you don't, it's undone automatically.
host.keepMsg: {iface} now uses the new settings. If anything broke, hit Revert — or just wait and they'll be undone.
host.tooLate: Too late — the change was already undone
host.reverted: No worries — your previous network settings are back
